root_cause.message: lock wait timeout caused by mysql row lock contention

expected.business_impact: /account/update production business path is affected by mysql_row_lock

primary_evidence.trace: Runtime trace follows api-gateway -> account-bff -> account-service -> mysql-account and localizes the main fault at account-service.
primary_evidence.log: Root service logs contain LockWaitTimeoutException and mysql_row_lock keywords.
primary_evidence.metric: Metric mysql.innodb.row_lock_waits breaches threshold on account-service.

non_root_noise: account-bff retry is a downstream failure signal of row lock wait
background audit-service warning is outside the affected call path
noise-service metric is normal and outside the affected call path
